visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair and a headband sits in a clinic chair, smiling with squinted eyes. His hairline is traced with blue ink markings. Two staff members in blue scrubs stand nearby. A black barber cape covers his torso. The setting is a brightly lit medical room with white cabinets and a white door. Blue text "植髮紀錄" is displayed in the center. (2) A male staff member in black scrubs and a mask uses a silver electric clipper to shave the back of the man's head. The man's hands are not visible under the black cape. The room has bright indoor lighting. On-screen text "剃髮中" and "頭大的另外一種優勢" appear as subtitles. (3) The man lies prone on a medical bed covered with a green drape. A female nurse in red scrubs and a blue cap uses her gloved hands to apply dark antiseptic liquid to his shaved scalp with white gauze. The background shows white medical shelves and a grey curtain. Text "(前置作業-消毒)" is visible. (4) A close-up shot shows the back of the man's head. Gloved hands press a blue cylindrical medical tool against his skin to apply anesthesia. A green drape is tucked under his chin. The room is brightly lit. Text "(上麻藥)" and an emoji are displayed. (5) The surgical process is shown in an extreme close-up. A medical professional wearing a magnifying headset uses a small metal punch tool to extract hair follicles from the scalp, causing small red puncture marks. White gauze is used to dab away blood. Text "(開始取髮)" appears. (6) A medical staff member in clear gloves uses fine tweezers to sort tiny hair follicles in a multi-section petri dish filled with liquid. The dish sits on a silver medical machine. A clipboard with a grid chart is in the background. Text "(篩選毛囊)" is visible. (7) The man sits on a bed wearing a light blue hospital gown and an earbud. He looks tired with slightly drooping eyes. A plush pillow and medical equipment are in the background. The lighting is soft. Subtitles record his speech about feeling dizzy. Text "(中場休息)" is shown. (8) The man lies on his back with his eyes covered by a white eye mask. A doctor in scrubs and a magnifying headset uses fine instruments to implant follicles into the front hairline. The area is red and swollen. Text "(植髮中)" and "Zzz" emojis appear. (9) A close-up of the man's forehead shows the newly implanted hair follicles, looking like a dense field of small red dots. A medical tool is seen dabbing at the hairline. The lighting is focused and bright. Subtitles capture the man's reaction to the density. (10) Ten days later, the man is in a professional studio with a grey backdrop and a large softbox light. He wears a black jacket and thick-framed glasses, pointing his fingers to his head. He demonstrates the healed hairline by lifting his bangs. Text "(植髮後 十天)" and slogans appear.
